problem.title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
problem.problemStatement: Given an array of positive integers and an integer Target, determine the minimum length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is at least Target.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and Target. • Second line contains N positive integers.
problem.output: Print the minimum length. If no such subarray exists, print 0.
